title: Age and sex structures, Kenya, 2020, 100 m grid
note: Estimates, summed inside each ward's boundary through WorldPop's statistics API (dataset wpgpas); 18–34 counts two fifths of the 15–19 band.

title: Declaration of results for the election of President, national tallying centre, by county (Form 34C summary), 2022
note: County and national totals as printed. Votes cast is valid plus rejected. The national valid total (14,213,137) is 110 more than the four candidates' votes added up (14,213,027), as printed.

title: 2013 presidential results by county
note: A third-party election observation site; its 2013 national totals match IEBC's declaration. County rows list only the four leading candidates and no votes cast. Parties and coalitions come from the candidates' widely reported 2013 tickets

title: Registered voters per county assembly ward, 2022
note: Ward pages of a third-party site carrying IEBC's 2022 register. Nairobi's wards add up to 2,415,310 against IEBC's declared 2,416,551. Mugumo-ini is spelt Mugumu-ini there.

title: 2022 candidates and registered voters by constituency
note: Constituency pages of a third-party site carrying IEBC's 2022 candidate list (official names and parties) and register; names are given here as other names then surname. Its county pages give the 2022 governor candidates; both lists are what the provisional results were checked against for completeness.

title: Open Buildings v3: building footprints
note: Footprints at confidence 0.65 or more, each counted in the ward its centre falls in, measured from the Voters map's house files (outlines to about 0.6 m) (CC BY 4.0). Small structures are under 40 m², large buildings 200 m² or more.

title: geoBoundaries Kenya ADM3 (wards)
note: Ward boundaries (Omare & Omare 2020, CC BY 4.0), simplified to about 3 m for the ward maps; areas are measured from them.

title: Register of voters per polling station, 2022 General Election
note: 712 pages, dated 3 August 2022; each ward is its streams added up. Githunguri's wards add up to 104,592 and Tigania West's to 70,283, the constituency registers Mzalendo gives.
